sites.name: kiln-row
sites.role: the marketplace (publisher); a repository whose site/ folder is served; its lock predates the Agent Card

sites.name: ashgrove-pottery
sites.role: seller peer: signs (key ashgrove-1) and will rotate its key properly

sites.name: brackenfold-ceramics
sites.role: seller peer: signs (key brackenfold-1) and will change signer without a rotation

sites.name: dovetail-weaving
sites.role: seller peer: flaky (goes offline and comes back)

sites.name: tidewater-studio
sites.role: the larger studio: publishes an A2A Agent Card at /.well-known/agent-card.json, not an agentic-web network

acts.onboarded: The marketplace with a lock written by init (with the daily workflow) over the four seller peers, no Agent Card in it; ashgrove-pottery and brackenfold-ceramics signed with their first keys, copperwick-glass unsigned, dovetail-weaving answering. Played by up.
acts.seller-rotates: ashgrove-pottery makes key ashgrove-2, publishes plumbline-rotation.json (ashgrove-1 -> ashgrove-2) and the new key record, and signs with ashgrove-2.
acts.seller-signer-swapped: brackenfold-ceramics is signed with a different key (brackenfold-other) and publishes that key's record; no rotation.
acts.seller-offline: dovetail-weaving stops answering (its port refuses connections).
acts.seller-back-changed: dovetail-weaving comes back from an outage CHANGED: agent deposit_taker added (loom_keeper calls it) and signed for the first time with a new key (dovetail-new). Needs seller-offline first; it brings the seller back up. Added after run 2026-11-18-first-five.
acts.card-skills-change: tidewater-studio's Agent Card gains the skill glaze-matcher and changes the description and tags of commission-quote.
acts.card-offline: tidewater-studio stops answering (the card's host refuses connections).
acts.card-back: World convenience, not in the journey: tidewater-studio answers again.
acts.seller-signs: copperwick-glass makes key copperwick-1, publishes its record and signs.
